text:
nina_onboarding: Quick brainstorm: run a lightweight micro-pulse at 24h/72h/7d post-onboard to capture three bits: happy? short rating (1-5) and one-line blocker. Use results to tweak healthscore and optionally kick a tiny playbook (1-touch or escalate). Low friction. Thoughts?

sam_ops: Love it. Keep payload tiny to avoid infra churn. Suggest {happy:bool, rating:int(1-5), note:str}. Webhook receiver should enforce dedupe+backoff.

maya_cs: Agree. Need mapping to our health buckets (green/amber/red). Also: who owns creating the playbooks? I can draft.

leo_data: For text we can run two quick rules + a small classifier for urgency. Proposed scoring: base = rating, unhappy subtract 2, urgent_text subtract 3. I'll publish a mapping table.

nina_onboarding: Proposed flow: 1) event triggers from onboarding service 2) send in-app prompt/email with link 3) hits /hooks/onboard_pulse 4) store raw and derived features 5) emit signal to healthscore and playbook engine.

alex_eng: Implementation note: receiver endpoint should be idempotent on (customer_id, milestone). Example payload:```POST /hooks/onboard_pulse
{ "customer_id":"C-4321", "milestone":"72h", "happy":false, "rating":2, "note":"can't find billing tab" }``` We'll return 202 for accepted and log to onboarding_feedback table. Add retry/backoff for transient failures.

sam_ops: Also add opt-out check before sending prompt + a skip_if_recent_submission flag. We should have max_per_month config. I'll own the policy and config.

arya_support: Add that CS reps can mark a customer as suppressed from automatic pulses (sensitive accounts). Need a small UI toggle in console.

leo_data: Draft mapping (will refine):
- rating >=4 and happy=true => green (+2)
- rating 3 or happy=true => neutral (0)
- rating <=2 or unhappy or urgent text => red (-3)
Text classifier bump: contains {"billing","error","blocked"} => urgent.
I'll output a CSV mapping and a micro-model endpoint by Wed.

maya_cs: I'll draft two playbooks: fast-touch (CS AE 24h ping + docs link) and escalate (create CSE ticket + 2-day SLA). Will post drafts.

nina_onboarding: Rollout plan: soft start 5% of new onboardees for 2 weeks, check response rate + false positives, then 25% then full. Metrics to watch: response rate, NPS proxy, percent that converts to green within 14 days, playbook escalation rate.

sam_ops: I'll add rate-limits on the webhook in #eng-infra and propose retention: raw feedback 90 days, derived 1 year.

alex_eng: I'll push receiver and a feature-flag gate. Can we add a test harness that simulates 1k events?

leo_data: I'll provide a small scoring script and SQL to backfill for last 30 days so we can sanity-check thresholds. Example SQL snippet:
```sql
INSERT INTO onboarding_feedback_derived (customer_id, milestone, score, urgent)
SELECT id, milestone, CASE WHEN rating >=4 THEN 2 WHEN rating =3 THEN 0 ELSE -3 END - (CASE WHEN note ~* 'billing|error|blocked' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) as score, (note ~* 'billing|error|blocked') as urgent
FROM onboarding_feedback_raw
WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 days';
```

maya_cs: Also: ensure playbook triggers include context (note text + last 3 events) and a clickable link to the customer's onboarding checklist. That speeds rep action.

cs-bot: deploy-bot: created PR #451: onboard-pulse-receiver, feature-flagged, tests added. Waiting review.

nina_onboarding: Owners: ops (@sam_ops) = webhook policy + suppression config; data (@leo_data) = scoring mapping + backfill; eng (@alex_eng) = receiver + tests + flag; CS (@maya_cs) = playbooks + rep UI snippet; support (@arya_support) = suppression UX. Sync Friday 10:30 to confirm rollout thresholds.

sam_ops: I'll post config PR and sample rate-limit settings tomorrow.

alex_eng: Linking PR when ready. Planning 5% soft launch next Wed if all green.

nina_onboarding: Perfect. Small ask: include a sample opt-out list in the PR so eng can validate skip logic.

maya_cs: Will add playbook text + checklist links by EOD.

cs-bot: reminder-bot: meeting scheduled: Friday 10:30 (onboard-pulse sync).
